text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Daiichi Ruby and
Mejiro McQueen chatting in the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"So I pointed it out to them:
'Yogurt is meant to be eaten by itself.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I believe that is a very thoughtful point to raise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, she insisted, "It's definitely delicious!"
and poured it right over the pancakes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, this has just the right amount of acidity and sweetness, making it quite a nice match.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That seems like a nice combination for breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Such a heartwarming anecdote about sweets,
unexpectedly revealed amidst such a poised demeanor...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to sweets, Mejiro McQueen-san
really has to be number one, doesn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard some Umamusume whispering nearby.
...I thought I heard some strange ranking being discussed, but the girls walked away right after.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Yes, along that street there is an apparel and accessories shop that I frequent.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just as expected of a place favored by the Grand Clan...!
Um, excuse me! I heard that you can design custom-made pendants here?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I often have custom accessories made
to match my dresses.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Could we also consult with you
about matching pair designs and the like?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I believe it is possible.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Actually, I was just thinking about making matching pendants with a friend!
If it's your recommendation, Ruby-san, it's sure to be great!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt that Satono Diamond
takes 1st place in the "Unflappable Ojou-sama" category~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt this takes first place in the "Incurably Curious Ojou-sama" rankings~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's that mysterious duo from the other day.
I wonder what on earth they're ranking.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby's Trainer?!
Well, you see! Um...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's the Tracen Academy
Ojou-sama Rankings!!
choice_data_list: Are you ranking the young ladies?
Are you ranking the young ladies?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ranking them is totally out of the question!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Each of these young ladies possesses a unique radiance!
We were simply exploring every single one of those dazzling lights!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to sweets, second to none!
The #1 "Sweets-Loving Ojou-sama"!
Mejiro McQueen-san!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The world is full of things she wants to know!
Ranked #1 for 'Unstoppably Curious Young Lady'!
Satono Diamond!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
And I want her to pay no heed to anyone at all!
She's #1 in "Rich young ladies who don't even acknowledge our existence and we just want to remain completely out of reach"!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
And so on and so forth! Many young ladies with
wonderful qualities are enrolled here!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Surely, many of the students are just as eager
to know the truth as we are!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I propose that an "Ojou-sama Ranking" is indispensable!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: So that was your intention.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We received reports that
someone was peeping around here.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry!
I didn't mean to trouble you...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I'm not particularly troubled.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Evaluation is entirely at the discretion of the observer.
Please feel free to judge as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Even though I wished
no one would pay me any mind...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Not only did we receive your words...
but a declaration of your resolve as well...?!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: My heart is truly full...!!
choice_data_list: Let's aim for 1st place as a "fast, strong, and clever lady!"
Let's keep blooming as untouchable flowers!
Let's keep blooming as untouchable flowers, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: My heart is truly full...!!
choice_data_list: Let's aim for 1st place as a "fast, strong, and clever lady!"
Let's keep blooming as untouchable flowers!
Let's keep blooming as untouchable flowers, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That is not something within my knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Although, if it was meant as encouragement to train hard
so that you would come to see me that way, then...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I shall handle it appropriately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――An 'Ojousama Ranking,' is it?
Show it to me whenever it's finished.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Naturally, that is my intention.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To be a presence praised by all—
that is the very mission of our clan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rankings or not,
she will stay true to herself from here on out.
I was utterly convinced of that.
